latest.title: Trading System Data Feed design on AWS Apache Kafka (MSK)
latest.description: Modernize your sell-side trading desk using Amazon MSK to eliminate technical debt across NYSE Pillar and Bonds feeds. From BBO sequence gap recovery and nanosecond timestamp normalization to building idempotent order books. Leverage MSK Express and Glue Schema Registry to mitigate "hot symbol" skew, prevent phantom liquidity, and fix price-scale errors. Ensure high-fidelity top-of-book data for pricing, smart order routing, and best-execution evidence with a resilient, ordered AWS streaming architecture.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
